tools.description: Record a research enquiry about a space company or market. Submission records demand for review. tools.name: check_research_status
tools.description: Retrieve the proposed scope, price offer, payment details, operator decision or research response using your receipt_id. Keep the receipt private. tools.name: respond_to_research_offer
tools.description: Respond using your private receipt_id. confirm_scope or correct_scope requires a proposed scope; correct_scope also requires correction text. accept_quote or decline_quote requires an unexpired quote; decline_quote may include a budget counter-offer. Acceptance records your choice of offer: no work

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "respond_to_research_offer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
